summary: Iteration 4 (dual image engine): FULL PASS. Backend pytest 41 passed / 3 skipped — 3 skipped are downstream of the OLD default-gemini success path (test_memories.py) which now returns 402 as designed. New /app/backend/tests/test_engines.py verifies the new architecture end-to-end: (a) POST /api/memories/generate engine='fal' → 200 with base64 image (>5000 chars), engine='fal', persisted to gallery. (b) engine='gemini' → HTTP 402 with actionable JSON detail mentioning 'Gemini' + 'quota'/'billing'/'429' — NOT 5xx. (c) POST /api/memories/generate-compare → 200 with {gemini:{ok:false,error:'...Gemini...quota...'}, fal:{ok:true, memory:{... image_base64, engine:'fal'...}}}, and the fal memory appears in GET /api/memories. (d) Validation: empty prompt / missing photo_ids → 400 on both endpoints; auth-gated → 401. (e) All returned Memory objects contain the new 'engine' field. Regression: full OTP auth flow (request-otp → hashed store → verify-otp → session_token), /auth/me, Photos CRUD all green. Enable billing …') AND testID='compare-card-fal' (Ready pill + rendered image). Real fal.ai image successfully generated in ~40s.

action_items: (Cleanup, non-blocking) /app/backend/server.py:17 still imports `emergentintegrations` (LlmChat, UserMessage, ImageContent) and lines 31-32 still require EMERGENT_LLM_KEY env + declare unused GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL='gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview' (also a WRONG model id). These are all dead code now that generation was moved to image_engines.py — remove the import, the env-var requirement, and the stale constant so the server doesn't crash if a future .env lacks EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.

(Nit) Consider exposing a per-engine 'engine' badge / filter in gallery so users can distinguish comparison entries at a glance (compare currently saves BOTH gemini and fal — with gemini failing, only fal is saved, which is fine, but a badge in gallery cards would still help).
critical_code_review_comments: image_engines.py: clean separation, correct google-genai + fal_client usage; SCENE_INSTRUCTION preserves identity requirements; base64/data-URI handling is safe both directions.

server.py `_classify_engine_error` correctly surfaces the Gemini 429/quota/billing/resource_exhausted case as HTTP 402 with an actionable message — verified live: content-type=application/json, body has `detail` including 'Gemini API key has no image-generation quota (429)'. A 4xx status also survives the Kubernetes ingress without being rewritten to a generic 502.

/api/memories/generate-compare: sensible design — runs both engines sequentially, saves the ok ones, returns per-engine {ok,error/memory}. Raises 400 ONLY if BOTH failed. This survives the current environment (gemini quota-blocked, fal OK).

Frontend describe.tsx correctly wires prompt+photo_ids to both `/memories/generate` (engine:'gemini' primary) and `/memories/generate-compare`; compare context persists results via CreateContext.setCompare and compare.tsx renders both cards with proper Ready/Failed pill and full error detail from the backend.
DEAD CODE: server.py still imports emergentintegrations and enforces EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — safe to remove (see action items).
